rows: Ruth and Boaz are Obed's recorded birth parents.
Exclude Naomi as an additional biological mother under this account.
Obed is also attributed to Naomi.
Preserve household restoration, caregiving, and social attribution as separate relationships.
Ruth 4 explicitly invokes Perez and Tamar.
Retain the ancestral reprise as source-supported.
Exclude exact event-for-event equivalence between Genesis 38 and Ruth 4.
Obed → Jesse → David continues the lineage.
The reprise now constrains the connected Davidic passage.
Zerahite and Levitical Heman have different recorded ancestries.
Keep their identities separate unless an explicit reconciliation is justified.
